about.title: A Dickinson family company that never stopped adding value.
text: Mackey Services exists to keep our communities powered, comfortable, and thriving by providing honest, expert HVAC, electrical, and generator services. What started as a local Texas service company in 1992 has grown into a three-trade team without losing the family way of doing business.

Today our wrapped green vans roll out of Dickinson every morning to homes and businesses across Galveston County and greater Houston. One number reaches a licensed HVAC contractor (#TACLA 112769C), a licensed electrical contractor (#TECL 558211), and generator specialists.

Less to pay. Better day. That's the Mackey way. It's more than a slogan. It's why we're the Home of the $49 Tune-Up, why the Happy Home Maintenance Plan rewards loyalty with real credits, and why 1,000+ neighbors rate us 4.9 stars.

We're the Home of the $49 Tune-Up. A licensed technician inspects, cleans, and optimizes your system so it runs efficiently through the long Gulf Coast cooling season. It's the cheapest insurance you can buy against a mid-August breakdown.

faqs.q: How often should my AC be serviced in the Houston area?
faqs.a: At least once a year, ideally each spring before the heat arrives. Gulf Coast systems run far more hours than the national average, and humidity is hard on coils and drain lines. Our Happy Home Maintenance Plan handles the schedule for you and adds 20% off repairs.

faqs.q: Should I repair or replace my AC?
faqs.a: A good rule of thumb: if the repair costs more than a third of a new system's price and your unit is 10+ years old, replacement usually wins on comfort and energy costs. We give you an honest assessment either way, and Happy Home members earn up to $1,250 in replacement credits.

faqs.q: Why should I consider a whole-home generator on the Gulf Coast?
faqs.a: Hurricane season and grid strain make outages a matter of when, not if. A whole-home standby generator starts automatically within seconds of an outage and keeps your AC, refrigerator, and medical equipment running. We install and service Kohler and Generac systems.

faqs.q: Do you install EV charging stations?
faqs.a: Yes. We install Level 2 home EV chargers, evaluate whether your panel can support the load, and handle any panel upgrade needed to charge safely and quickly.

facts.heading: Across the Gulf Coast
facts.text: Our wrapped green vans serve more than 50 Gulf Coast communities across Galveston County and greater Houston, out of one shop at 5252 FM 517 Rd E in Dickinson.

facts.heading: What the two seasonal visits cover
items: Cooling: electrical components and connections, voltage and amperage, refrigerant pressure, accessible ductwork, contactor and capacitor, outdoor condenser coil rinse, a visual inspection of the evaporator coil, thermal operation, drain-line cleaning and clearing, and UV light inspection where one is fitted

Heating: gas lines and gas pressure, ignition sequence and burners, heat exchanger and flame sensor, safety limits and switches, electrical connections and terminals, drain-line cleaning and clearing, and refrigerant pressures and heat-kit sequence on heat pumps
An electronic system health report follows each visit

facts.heading: Rebates and tax credits
items: CenterPoint and TNMP utility instant discounts on 15.2+ SEER2 equipment, applied through participating contractors
Manufacturer rebate windows run seasonally on Lennox and American Standard equipment
The federal 25C and 25D credits ended for any system installed after 31 December 2025
The Texas HOMES and HEAR programs are funded but not yet open, and we are tracking the launch

facts.heading: Equipment lifespans here
facts.text: An AC condenser lasts 10 to 15 years on the Gulf Coast against 15 to 20 further north, because salt air corrodes outdoor coils and a nine-month cooling season doubles the runtime hours. Coastal homes in Kemah, Galveston and San Leon see the shortest lifespans.
